title: CorrelationRegistry
description: Correlation id propagation (planning/14 §2): the names every hop uses to carry one id per logical operation (client → API → outbox → job → worker), read by the API and, through the generated `ai_stylist_generated.kernel`, by the workers. Which ids are valid is the event envelope's `correlationId` rule (packages/contracts/events/envelope.json: pattern, minLength, maxLength), never restated here. `vectors` are the labelled ids every check of that rule (the envelope schema, the API header, the worker header) is tested against. Renaming `header` or `logKey` breaks every client, worker, dashboard and alert that uses it; adding vectors is free.

header.description: HTTP request and response header that carries the id, lowercase (Node and Starlette expose incoming headers lowercased).

logKey.description: Log key and span attribute name the id is written under, snake_case.

accepted.description: Ids every check MUST accept (a UUID, a ULID, prefixed ids, both length bounds).

rejected.description: Ids every check MUST reject: out of the length bounds, separators, a trailing newline, header injection, and non-ASCII letters and digits that `\w` or `\d` would match in a Unicode-mode regex.
